home.title: Little Alchemy
home.confirmText: Your current game will be permanently erased.

effects.dock: +{{count}} slots in the dock while on the island
effects.flood: Placed on an empty grass tile: turns it into a water block

dock.empty: No cards. Your producers will create some over time.

celebrations.paused: {{icon}} {{name}} is paused. Sell or merge some cards.
celebrations.victoryText: You raised the Stone Circle: the Stone Age comes to an end. The next world is coming soon: your island is still here, keep growing it!

stone.name: Pebble
stone.desc: A pebble. It doesn't do much, but it does it with conviction. Two pebbles rubbing together is already a party.

stick.name: Stick
stick.desc: The Cro-Magnon's best friend. Good for everything: hitting, scratching, pointing, and looking busy.

mud.name: Mud
mud.desc: Brown, sticky, slightly suspicious. Cro-Magnons love it. Nobody knows why.

water.name: Water
water.desc: Wet. It's its only talent, but what a talent. Placed on empty grass, it turns it into a pond.

clay.name: Clay
clay.desc: Mud that went to school. Ready to be fired and become somebody.

seed.name: Seeds
seed.desc: Tiny, but full of dreams of grandeur. Give them water and a little love.

log.name: Log
log.desc: A lumberjack got it. Big, heavy, perfect for rolling. Brilliant ideas are on the way.

flint_tool.name: Flint Tool
flint_tool.desc: The Swiss army knife of the Stone Age. Cuts, pierces, impresses the neighbors. Turns a Cro-Magnon into a Hunter.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: A little flash of genius. Add some wood and it's party time: welcome, Campfire!

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.desc: Smells strong and pays big. Careful, a wolf may be lurking nearby. Or two.

grilled_steak.name: Grilled Steak
grilled_steak.desc: The favorite dish of the big guys. A Hunter or Miner who bites into one goes turbo (×3) for 60 s!

wolf.name: Wild Wolf
wolf.desc: Howls at the moon and begs for steak. With a Cro-Magnon and a bit of patience, it'll become a very good boy.

ochre.name: Ochre
ochre.desc: The red pigment of great artists. Give it to a Cro-Magnon: they'll think they're Picasso.

pot.name: Pottery
pot.desc: Mud that has known fire. Result: a sturdy pot, very proud of itself. Ideal for keeping wheat cool.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.desc: Golden, crunchy, full of potential. Flour, cow or granary: wheat can do it all.

flour.name: Flour
flour.desc: Wheat that got hit on the head with a rock. It came out all white, and a bit dusty.

dough.name: Dough
dough.desc: Soft, sticky, in a good mood. A little time in the warmth and it becomes somebody.

bread.name: Bread
bread.desc: Warm, crusty, irresistible. Any worker who eats it works ×3 faster for 30 s!

wool.name: Wool
wool.desc: Soft, curly, slightly sheepish. Two piles of wool and a bit of patience: that's cloth.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.desc: Cloth! The most stylish Cro-Magnons discover a calling as Shamans.

milk.name: Milk
milk.desc: Fresh today, straight from the cow. Give it to an animal: it runs around everywhere (×3 for 30 s).

leather.name: Leather
leather.desc: Cow skin, but better. Stretched over a log, it makes a thunderous drum.

wheel.name: Wheel
wheel.desc: THE great invention. Round, practical, and it rolls all by itself. Two wheels and a log, and you invent the Cart.

heat.name: Heat
heat.desc: Hot stuff! Cooks meat, dough and clay. Don't hug it.

rock_deposit.name: Boulder
rock_deposit.desc: A big rock that makes little rocks. It doesn't move, it doesn't talk, it pays.

bush.name: Bush
bush.desc: A generous bush: sticks and berries aplenty. Watch out for thorns.

cro_magnon.name: Cro-Magnon
cro_magnon.desc: Our hero! A bit gruff, very motivated, brings back shells all day long. Can learn a trade with the right tool.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.desc: Throws pointy things at things that run. Brings back shells and raw meat. Loves steak.

hut.name: Hut
hut.desc: A roof, four walls, zero plumbing. Earns shells and welcomes a new villager now and then.

mud_puddle.name: Mud Puddle
mud_puddle.desc: A puddle, but a pro puddle. Supplies mud, and sometimes clay on lucky days.

miner.name: Miner
miner.desc: Hits rocks all day and asks for more. Pebbles, shells and a bit of ochre when inspired.

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lumberjack.desc: Has an axe, a beard and a great passion for trees (especially when they fall). Sticks, logs, shells.

tribal_hut.name: Tribal Hut
tribal_hut.desc: The height of Stone Age chic. Big shell income, and a new recruit every minute.

dog.name: Prehistoric Dog
dog.desc: Man's best friend, prehistoric edition. Picks up everything and expands your dock by 15 slots.

mammoth.name: Mammoth
mammoth.desc: Big. Very big. Woolly. Brings in a mountain of shells without asking for anything but space.

painter.name: Cave Painter
painter.desc: Draws bison on the walls and everyone loves it. Everyone on the island earns more shells!

field.name: Field
field.desc: A nice wheat field, all ready. It loves being watered: neighboring water blocks boost it.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.desc: Baa! She grazes, earns shells, and loses her wool without complaint. A real pro.

cow.name: Cow
cow.desc: Moo. Milk, leather, shells: she gives everything and only asks for wheat. A model of generosity.

drum.name: Drum
drum.desc: Boom, boom, boom! The rhythm makes all nearby workers want to work (even those who didn't feel like it).

granary.name: Granary
granary.desc: A big shed to store the harvest. It earns nothing, but it makes room. Lots of room.

cart.name: Cart
cart.desc: Two wheels, a platform, and off goes the merchandise. A very big income for not an ounce of effort.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.desc: Mumbles, waves feathers, and the workers around work faster. We don't ask questions.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.desc: Crackles, smells good and warms little hearts. Workers next to the fire work faster. And it makes heat.

tutorial.merge: Hold the Pebble, lift it up, then drop it onto the Stick to craft a tool!
tutorial.hunter: With this Flint Tool you can turn a Cro-Magnon into a Hunter: hold it, lift it up to the island, then drop it on them. It costs {{cost}} 🐚, so save up!
tutorial.shells: Your villagers earn shells 🐚 all by themselves: your Cro-Magnon brings in one per second. Keep an eye on this counter!
tutorial.expand: Spend your shells to expand the island. Tap 🛠️!
tutorial.goal: Here's your next goal. Tap it to open the grimoire and see every recipe. Have fun!
tutorial.discovery: You just discovered the Flint Tool! Every new discovery pops up like this: read its description, it tells you what it's for. All your discoveries are kept in the grimoire.

intro.title: Oops… the Stone Age!
intro.p1: Our scientists messed up again: their time machine dropped us right in Prehistory, with two pebbles, two sticks and a very grumpy Cro-Magnon.
intro.p2: To get back home, we need to move time forward! Merge items, grow your island and uncover new inventions: every discovery brings us closer to the present.
intro.p3: (They promised it was the last time.)
